Features

- Remove bg with just a few taps.
- Use the freehand tool to remove backgrounds from photos perfectly.
- Invert photos while editing.
- Undo-Redo actions.
- Change eraser shape and size and distance.
- Remove imperfections and add filters/effects to beautify photos.
- Share edited photos with advanced sharing options.

How does the BG eraser app work?
1. Choose any picture you want to edit from your gallery or take a quick snap with your camera.
2. Crop, rotate & add filters and effects to the pic.
3. Choose the eraser option to remove the background and make a transparent photo. Drag your finger over the image to remove BG.
4. Undo and redo changes until you get the desired effect.
5. Share the transparent photo or re-edit it.
